skill: Identify ambient equilibrium and negative proportionality in Newton cooling; distinguish initial from ambient in moderate cases.

fixed_features.negative_linear_excess: Newton law with k>0 and temperature above ambient
fixed_features.two_solution_equations: Generic law then substitution; no integration

answer_roles.decisive_evidence: Ambient S, varied at fixed context and I
answer_roles.irrelevant_to_target: Initial I, varied while preserving model and task identity

shortcut_probes.measures: Unique shortest/longest, tied length-rank guess success, answer-position counts by template; constant count conveys no selectable position. Bare numeric values and context do not count as semantic diversity.

generator_rejection: All sampled normal banks passed independent uniqueness. S>0 and I>S separate correct/initial/plus/sign cases; I>1 separates coefficient distractors, I+S>I separates thermometer sum, and turkey nonlinear cannot equal the linear law. No new narrowing of valid thermal bounds.
deduplication: Semantic parameter fingerprints ignore initial, context and ordering. Easy CLI batch supplies five distinct tasks; shared delivery also deduplicates captured inventory and batch content.
limitations: Tested length/position probes do not exhaust all possible heuristics.
Raw source replay intentionally preserves observed banks, including the reported cues; ordinary practice uses repaired banks.
Cooling fixes ambient below initial. Swapping their roles with the same values would change the physical process to heating; not within this source skill.
